material_result.name: Exact-optimal residuals can require full total semantic support
material_result.quantifiers: For every n>=2, a cheaper parity phase and an optimal first gate give exact residual cost C-1; every optimal residual uses all n+1 coordinates. Violations of every linear hole cap occur beyond every arity threshold.
material_result.scope: Refutes one internal optimal-support premise; no MCSP oracle reduction, NP-hardness or PvsNP solution.

remaining_mathematical_blocker: Neither a general short-certificate guarantee nor an eligible-class SAT algorithm with the required uniform worst-case savings has been proved. The unrestricted Partial-MCSP to total-MCSP bridge also remains missing.
